picks.headline: Utopai Is 'World's Largest Independent AI-Native Film and TV Studio,' Will Premiere 3 Movies and 2 Series in 2027
picks.excerpt: Utopai Studios says it has 25 original projects in production on its AI-native pipeline, with three films and two series slated for 2027 premieres.
picks.rationale: A dated, committed slate — 25 projects, 2027 premieres — turns the AI-native studio from demo reel into a delivery schedule creative teams can plan against.

picks.headline: Adobe Firefly Overhauls Its Audio Capabilities With Music, Speech, and Sound Effects All Now in One Place
picks.excerpt: Firefly's Generate Music, Generate Speech and Generate Sound Effects go generally available, sized to a video's length and mood, with ElevenLabs voices as an option.
picks.rationale: The most directly actionable release in the pool: temp score, scratch VO and SFX move next to the picture edit, collapsing an outsourced post step to a same-day task.

picks.headline: Phil Tippett Closes Berkeley Studio After Nearly 40 Years
picks.excerpt: The Oscar-winning animation and VFX pioneer is auctioning decades of artifacts as he closes his Berkeley studio, though he says he won't retire: “I will die with my sword in my hand.”
picks.rationale: The freshest item in the pool and the loudest signal on craft economics — a landmark practical-effects house folding while generated creature work scales.

picks.headline: “Saying you're working with AI is like saying you have an STD,” argues Tilly Norwood creator
picks.excerpt: Eline van der Velden says she has signed hundreds of NDAs with companies quietly exploring AI, and urges public broadcasters to invest openly in the space.
picks.rationale: Names the disclosure taboo with hard evidence — hundreds of NDAs — which is exactly the question every team now has to answer about documenting its own pipeline.

picks.headline: Flying Bark Enters the Avatar State with 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender'
picks.excerpt: Animation director Christian Barkel and CEO Barbara Stephen break down the hybrid 2D/CG workflow behind the new feature: three years of new tools, no rigs, and every movement drawn by hand.
picks.rationale: A studio that spent three years building custom tooling to keep hand-drawn motion at feature scale — the concrete counter-case to 'automate it', with the pipeline shown.
